exposure: Thrombocytopenia associated with acute fatty liver of pregnancy (AFLP)
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women diagnosed with thrombocytopenia.
finding: Gestational thrombocytopenia is the most common cause of low platelet count in pregnancy, and feto-maternal complication rates are significantly lower in cases of gestational thrombocytopenia compared to thrombocytopenia associated with other pathological conditions like pre-eclampsia, HELLP syndrome, AFLP, dengue fever, and chronic hypertension.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was mentioned as a fetal complication.
